title: PRESSER | Christian Brown - Maui Preview (11-19-26)
text: So you know, the team's been number one and points allowed so far this season. How important have you been in maintaining the interior defense? >> Uh, you know, we've been working on defense since we got here in the summertime. So just continue to just be in the gaps and just show uh try to discourage teams to just even want to drive in there. Uh, but yeah, we've been doing a great job just being in the gaps. That's how we generate a lot of our turnovers. >> What is the scout on Clemson now that Nichols is in the rearview mirror? >> Uh, scout on Clemson is they're a great team offensively. Uh, a lot of great shooters, a lot of great players. So it's just sticking to our roots um being between the man and the basket and just playing defense that we've been playing. Uh, we feel very confident. >> You know, playing these bigger high major teams, you know, that's going to come with playing against teams with more size and physicality. You know, how has practice in these first couple of games prepared you for now and the rest of the season? >> I think since we got here in June been preparing us for these moments uh we're a very physical team as a lot of people in the country know. So just going against each other being physical uh I don't think it'll surprise us the amount of physical physicality that Clemson going to play with and just the height wise. Um, we're just athletic and just a bunch of dogs. >> What does a successful trip entail in Maui besides just winning games? >> Just winning. Um, you know, we all competitors. We want to win. So it's a trip for me personally just winning the Maui Classic and just showing the world uh what we about. >> Outside of basketball, what are you most looking forward to about the trip? >> Uh, just going to Hawaii. Uh, it's my first time being out there. So just um experiencing the landscape, uh looking at the beach and the beautiful water, just experiencing the Hawaiian culture. Uh, I heard it's beautiful out there and the culture is fun. So just having the opportunity to be out there. >> Last question. Uh, even part of the Puerto Rico trip you could draw on to take with you over there in Puerto Rico? >> Uh, you know, just being together uh Puerto Rico we spent a lot of time with each other as a team and that translates on the court. So just using this time also to you know gain some more chemistry cuz the season is early and we have a lot games ahead of us, so using this trip to gain more chemistry, um find each other's sweet spots and just gel together. >> Thanks, >> Yep, thank you.
